brief:
Teachers and students held a protest in Gaza demanding protection of the right to education and provision of a dignified school environment as winter approaches, Shehab Wire reported. The demonstration highlighted the deprivation faced by more than 850,000 students lacking adequate learning conditions.

The protesters called for securing proper educational facilities and circumstances for students amid deteriorating conditions in the enclave.

title: Gaza teachers and students demand protection of education rights
